subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Family of small runtime objects and their helpers reconstructed from validated IR: UI sub-control constructors seeded by UIControlWindowInitialization, player-options field setters seeded by PlayerOptionsInitializer, per-frame vehicle packed-field/bitfield decoders consumed by VehiclePhysicsTimeStep, a session lap-data allocator, a noise-value generator, and file/resource-string utilities. All owners are UnknownObject; grouping is DERIVED from shared callers, shared callees and shared field patterns, not from proven class identity.

summary: 38 functions reconstructed as a small collection of short-lived runtime objects. (1) UIControlWindowInitialization (0x004A70E0) builds a UI sub-control tree via a family of 3- and 5-dword thiscall constructors, each storing a distinct vtable/interface global at +0x0 and seeding 0/-1 value pairs; a zero-initializer clears a 21-dword UI block. (2) PlayerOptionsInitializer (0x004AA270) configures a player-options struct through setters that copy label strings via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc, write option fields at +0x14..+0x20 (int/byte/short variants over overlapping offsets), flag-gate extra writes, and always end by delegating to ShortComputation_1b70. (3) VehiclePhysicsTimeStep (0x004C73F0) per frame decodes packed physics fields at +0x24..+0x26 and bit-packed dwords at +0x2C/+0x30 through trivial getters with fixed scale constants. (4) A session lap-data struct is constructed (sentinels + zero block) and its per-lap float/byte arrays allocated and sentinel-filled. (5) Standalone helpers: game-mode-to-path-prefix formatter, candidate-path file finder, and a validated resource-string copier. Class identity of every object is UNKNOWN; all groupings are DERIVED or GUESS.

Packed scalar decoder on PackedPhysicsFieldCarrier: unpacks byte +0x24 (x0.05), int16 +0x26 (x0.002), byte +0x25 (x0.05) into float outputs through CRTFtol truncation; returns the third truncated int.
Indexed packed-field decoder: scales byte at entry index a2+18 by 0.00390625 into *a3 and int16 at 2*a2+22 by 0.0099999998 into *a4; returns raw int16.
Bitfield decoder on PackedPhysicsFieldCarrier: extracts bits 17-31 of the dword at +0x2C, scales by 0.1, returns double.
Bitfield decoder on PackedPhysicsFieldCarrier: extracts 5-bit field (bits 12-16) of +0x2C, scales by 0.032258064 (1/31), returns double.
Bitfield getter on PackedPhysicsFieldCarrier: extracts 4-bit nibble (bits 8-11) of +0x2C and returns it minus 1.
Bitfield decoder on PackedPhysicsFieldCarrier: extracts low 7 bits of +0x2C, subtracts bias 64, scales by 0.015873017 (1/63), returns double.
Bit test getter on PackedPhysicsFieldCarrier: reads dword at +0x30, returns (value >> a2) & 1.
Bitfield getter on PackedPhysicsFieldCarrier: returns bits 28-30 of the dword at +0x30.
Bitfield decoder on PackedPhysicsFieldCarrier: extracts 2-bit field (bits 22-23) of +0x30, scales by 0.33333334 (1/3), returns double.
Bitfield getter on PackedPhysicsFieldCarrier: returns bits 15-21 of the dword at +0x30.
Gaussian-approximation noise generator: popcount of a hash-based PRNG result as a binomial term combined with a noise-table float, centered and scaled.

SessionLapData constructor/initializer: zeroes an 8-dword block at +0x40 and fields +0x0/+0x30/+0x8C/+0x90/+0x94/+0xA4, sets sentinels -1 at +0x4/+0x24/+0x2C and float -1.0 at +0x28, then delegates to StructResetReinitializer.

SessionLapData per-lap array allocator: resets via StructResetReinitializer, sets mode flags +0xC/+0x60 from session type dword_7C56A4, caps lap count from dword_8ACF8C at 128 into +0x88, allocates two float arrays (+0x8C/+0x90) and one byte array (+0x94) via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, records count +0x98, fills all with float -1.0 sentinels / 0.

function_roles.role: UiWindowBlock zero-initializer: zeroes 21 consecutive dwords (+0x0..+0x50) of the receiver and returns it.

Candidate-path file finder for season/race data files: appends extension when needed, probes custom/season/common directories, closes and copies the first openable path (return 0), otherwise guarded debug log and return -1.

Validated resource-string copier: checks SeasonRacesSectionFinder and StringKeyedLinkedListSearch, fetches entry via DataEntryAccessor, copies into caller buffer with capacity a2-1 via sub_587DD0, null-terminates; returns 0 on success, 1 on section/key failure.

classes.name: PlayerOptionsStruct
classes.responsibility: Player-options configuration object configured by PlayerOptionsInitializer (0x004AA270): stores paired option values, label strings copied via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc, and flag-gated sub-fields; every mutating path ends by delegating to the shared finalizer ShortComputation_1b70. Widths of the +0x14..+0x20 fields differ across the setter variants (int/byte/short), implying overlapping or union-interpreted storage; identity and true layout are unconfirmed.

classes.name: UiRangePairControl
classes.responsibility: Generic 5-dword UI sub-control block constructed by UIControlWindowInitialization (0x004A70E0): vtable/interface slot at +0x0 followed by two (min=0, max=-1) range-bound pairs at +0x4/+0x8 and +0xC/+0x10. Each of the eleven instances stores a distinct vtable global (0x005ACBCC..0x005ACC74), so the concrete UI widget types are likely distinct but are unidentifiable from this packet; the class is a defensible grouping of structurally identical constructors, not a proven common type.

classes.name: UiStateSentinelControl
classes.responsibility: Small 3-dword UI sub-control block constructed by UIControlWindowInitialization (0x004A70E0): vtable/interface slot at +0x0, a state/counter field seeded 0 at +0x4, and a handle/index seeded -1 (invalid) at +0x8. Two instances with distinct vtable globals (0x005ACBFC, 0x005ACC08); concrete type identity unknown.

classes.name: UiMultiRangeControl
classes.responsibility: 7-dword UI sub-control block constructed by UIControlWindowInitialization (0x004A70E0): vtable/interface slot at +0x0 followed by three 0/-1 pairs at +0x4..+0x18. Single instance storing global off_5ACBF0; whether this is a third-range variant of UiRangePairControl or a distinct type is unknown.

classes.name: UiWindowBlock
classes.responsibility: 21-dword UI memory block cleared by a straight-line zero-initializer invoked from UIControlWindowInitialization (0x004A70E0). No vtable slot is written, so this may be the enclosing UI window object or a data-only sub-block; the semantics of each zeroed dword are unknown.

classes.name: PackedPhysicsFieldCarrier
classes.responsibility: Vehicle-physics packed-field carrier read per frame by VehiclePhysicsTimeStep (0x004C73F0) and related paths: three compact scalar fields at +0x24..+0x26 decoded with fixed scales, and two bit-packed dwords at +0x2C and +0x30 exposing typed subfields through trivial thiscall getters. Concrete owner object unidentified; grouping is DERIVED from the shared caller and the two bitfield source dwords.

classes.name: IndexedPackedFieldContainer
classes.responsibility: Indexed container of packed per-entry fields decoded by 0x004B28F0: a byte field at entry byte-index a2+18 scaled by 0.00390625 and a signed int16 at entry byte-index 2*a2+22 scaled by 0.0099999998. The entry stride is derived from the index math, but no fixed base offsets can be declared from this packet, so the field set is deliberately empty.

classes.name: NoiseValueGenerator
classes.responsibility: Per-frame noise source producing an approximately normal distribution: a hash-based PRNG result is popcounted into a binomial term, combined with a float from a noise table indexed by a byte counter stored at +0x0, then centered and scaled. The noise-table array base (this+257 dwords) is visible in the raw source but its absolute offset is outside the packet's allowed evidence, so no table field is declared.

classes.name: SessionLapData
classes.responsibility: Session/race-timing struct with per-lap storage. Constructor 0x004BB7A0 zeroes a block at +0x40 and a set of scalars, plants -1 / float -1.0 sentinels, and delegates to StructResetReinitializer. Allocator 0x004BB810 sets session-mode flags (+0xC/+0x60) from global session type dword_7C56A4, stores a lap count (capped 128) at +0x88, allocates two float arrays (+0x8C/+0x90) and one byte array (+0x94) and fills them with -1.0f/0 sentinels. The allocator was previously mislabeled Vehicle_Array_Buffer_Allocator (legacy ABI lead name); owner class remains UnknownObject.
evidence_refs: abi:lead LEGACY name Vehicle_Array_Buffer_Allocator conflicts with the SessionLapDataAllocator interpretation; owner remains UnknownObject.

interfaces.name: OptionFinalizationHook
interfaces.purpose: Shared post-assignment finalization invoked at the end of every PlayerOptionsStruct mutator (0x004A7010, 0x004B1AC0, 0x004B1C20, 0x004B1D90, 0x004B1F50); the mutators return its result. A replacement must keep calling it after field writes to preserve observable behavior.

interfaces.name: StructResetContract
interfaces.purpose: Shared struct-reset/reinitialization invoked by both SessionLapData functions (0x004BB7A0 constructor and 0x004BB810 allocator) before deeper field setup.

compatibility_contracts.name: PlayerOptionsStructLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: Player-options object must expose writable option fields at +0x0C/+0x10 (paired values, mirrored to +0x14/+0x18) and flag-gated storage at +0x14..+0x20 written by int/byte/short setter variants, plus a string buffer fed by StringCopyWithBufferRealloc; every mutator path must end by calling the finalizer at 0x004A1B70 and returning its result.

compatibility_contracts.name: UiRangePairControlLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: UI sub-control blocks seeded by UIControlWindowInitialization keep a vtable/interface pointer at +0x0 followed by (min=0, max=-1) pairs at 0x4/0x8 and 0xC/0x10; a 3-pair variant extends the pattern to +0x14/+0x18, and a 3-dword variant carries a state field +0x4 and handle/index +0x8. Each instance is distinguished by the vtable global stored at +0x0.

compatibility_contracts.name: SessionLapDataLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: Session lap-data struct must keep a capped lap count at +0x88, two float arrays at +0x8C/+0x90 and a byte array at +0x94 (with count +0x98), session-mode flags at +0xC/+0x60 keyed off global dword_7C56A4, and -1 / -1.0 sentinels; all arrays are allocated through 0x00587C03 and filled with -1.0f/0.

compatibility_contracts.name: PackedPhysicsBitfieldLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: Vehicle physics carrier keeps scaled scalar fields at +0x24 (byte, 0.05), +0x25 (byte, 0.05) and +0x26 (int16, 0.002), plus two bit-packed dwords: +0x2C with subfields at bits 0-6 (biased 7-bit /63), 8-11 (nibble -1), 12-16 (5-bit /31) and 17-31 (15-bit /10), and +0x30 with a per-bit test, bits 15-21 (/0x7F), 22-23 (2-bit /3) and 28-30 (3-bit).

compatibility_contracts.name: FileFinderContract
compatibility_contracts.description: File finder probes candidates in order (custom dir a3; else season dir/name with byte_5EA438 fallback; else 'common' variant), returns 0 on the first openable path (closing the handle and copying the resolved path), and returns -1 with a guarded debug log when nothing opens.

compatibility_contracts.name: StringCopyValidationContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Resource-string copier validates a season-races section and a string key, copies the entry into the caller buffer with capacity a2-1 and null-terminates it; returns 0 on success and 1 on section/key lookup failure.

compatibility_contracts.name: GameModePathPrefixMapping
compatibility_contracts.description: Game-mode index 0-6 maps to a path-prefix string global (0x005CD6FC..0x005CD6CC) that is combined with a suffix via '%s%s'; any other index leaves the output buffer empty and returns 0.

unresolved: Every object owner is UnknownObject; no live reference or RTTI evidence identifies a concrete game class.

The 14 distinct vtable/interface globals (0x005ACBCC, 0x005ACBD8, 0x005ACBE4, 0x005ACBF0, 0x005ACBFC, 0x005ACC08, 0x005ACC20, 0x005ACC2C, 0x005ACC38, 0x005ACC44, 0x005ACC50, 0x005ACC5C, 0x005ACC68, 0x005ACC74) imply distinct UI sub-control types; common ownership of the UiRangePairControl field layout is NOT proven and the grouping is a GUESS.
Meaning of the 0/-1 value pairs is not confirmed: state/counter vs range (min,max) bounds vs sentinel handles are competing DERIVED interpretations.
Why 0x004A7010 stores a3/a4 twice at mirrored offsets (+0xC/+0x14, +0x10/+0x18) is unexplained; duplicate-field semantics unknown.
The PlayerOptionsStruct string buffer location is not exposed; setter variants copy strings via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc but the destination offset is unrecorded.

Int/byte/short widths overlap at +0x14..+0x20 across the setter variants (0x004B1AC0 int, 0x004B1C20 byte, 0x004B1F50 short); union/bit-packed interpretation is a GUESS, distinct-object alternative not excluded.
Game-mode index enum (0..6) meaning undefined; prefix globals' actual string contents are legacy/DERIVED labels only.
0x004B1AB0 identity body purpose unknown: getter-style adapter, virtual-slot placeholder, or hook point; raw source shows only pass-through.
For 0x004B26D0 the pairing of globals flt_59E448/flt_5ACCB0 with the 0.05 vs 0.002 scales is unproven; for 0x004B28F0 the pairing of flt_59E444/flt_5AC988 is unproven.
0x004B28F0's a2 entry selector and the containing array layout are undocumented; the class IndexedPackedFieldContainer has no fixed-offset fields.
The inverse-of-pack claim for the +0x2C 15-bit field (0x004B2980) is external skeleton prose, not packet evidence.
Semantic meaning of the +0x2C and +0x30 bitfield subfields (nibble/5-bit/7-bit/15-bit/2-bit/3-bit/bit-test) is unknown.

For 0x004B3CE0 the roles of globals flt_59E450/flt_5ACCF8 (0.5 vs 0.35355338 scale) are unverified; 0.35355338 ~ 1/sqrt(8) is inferred; the noise-table array base (this+257 dwords) is out of allowed evidence and not declared as a field.
SessionLapData sentinels -1 and float -1.0 mark invalid/not-set but semantics are unconfirmed; -1082130432 equals the IEEE-754 float -1.0f bit pattern (DERIVED).
Legacy ABI lead name Vehicle_Array_Buffer_Allocator conflicts with the SessionLapDataAllocator interpretation of 0x004BB810; owner remains UnknownObject.

FileFinder format-string globals (0x005BE860, 0x005C6784, 0x005D30B4) association with '%s%s'/'%s%s%s'/'%scommon\%s' is DERIVED, not pinned in raw source; sub_587DB0 (file open) and sub_587C20 (path suffix check) semantics are inferred; a4 is unused; byte_5EA438 fallback semantics unknown.
StringCopyWithValidation a4 argument meaning (section identifier?) unconfirmed; sub_587DD0 copy semantics unconfirmed; structural-twin relationship to sub_45B5C0 not verified.
UiWindowBlock identity and the semantics of its 21 zeroed dwords are unknown; whether it is the enclosing UI window object or a data-only sub-block is undetermined.
NoopStub2 (0x004B0170) replaces what may have been a shared hook; origin and purpose unknown.
off_5ACBF0 and the other +0x0 vtable globals are labeled vtable pointers by prior analysis, which this packet's evidence does not independently prove.
